problem_statement: Backport the upstream redirect-header security fix to urllib3 1.26.16. A cross-origin redirect must remove Cookie regardless of header spelling, while same-origin cookies, public headers, and an explicitly configured redirect policy retain their intended behavior.
notes: Selected existing suite: test/test_retry.py (59 target cases), plus one external loopback security test and three controls; this is not the entire urllib3 suite.

reviewed-tests.patch adapts only two target-context assertions to the upstream Cookie-removal header policy and preserves the existing function signatures and test identities. Its SHA-256 and review reason are frozen in harness.toml; upstream-test-expectation-change.patch records the upstream assertion change.

urllib3_legacy_warnings.py suppresses only the distutils Version classes deprecation emitted by the historical pytest-freezegun helper. The plugin source and complete dependency lock are included; no urllib3 source or oracle is installed in the image.
Upstream source and advisory: https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3 and https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/security/advisories/GHSA-v845-jxx5-vc9f.
The source-only reference.patch excludes the separately reviewed test assertion patch. Oracle evaluation uses loopback servers and requires no external network.
